groups.defect: Backup-code verification uses non-constant-time string comparisons in both login and disable-2FA paths.
groups.rationale: Both report the same comparison mistake repeated in separate endpoints. Each location needs its comparison updated.

groups.defect: Non-atomic backup-code consumption allows concurrent requests to reuse a code or overwrite another consumption.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same unprotected read-modify-write sequence. The second elaborates its lost-update consequence; making consumption atomic at this location resolves both reports.

groups.defect: The disable-2FA endpoint calls replaceAll on a backupCode value without validating that it is a string.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same truthy non-string input causing an unhandled TypeError at the same call. Their references to the login counterpart do not add a distinct defect requiring a unified comment.
